87
RAJYA  SABHA
————
List of Questions for ORAL ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Friday, February 7, 2014/Magha 18, 1935 (Saka)
————
(Ministries :  Agriculture; Chemicals and Fertilizers; Communications and
Information Technology; Consumer Affairs, Food and Public Distribution;
Food Processing Industries; Law and Justice; Railways; Statistics and
Programme Implementation)
Total number of questions — 20
Pendency and disposal of rape cases
*241. SHRI SUKHENDU SEKHAR
ROY: Will the Minister of LAW AND
JUSTICE be pleased to state:
(a) the number of rape cases pending in
various High Courts and Supreme Court as
on date, State-wise; and
(b) the number of rape cases disposed
of during the last three years, State-wise?
Fall in procurement of rice and wheat
*242. SHRI MOHD. ALI KHAN: Will
the Minister of CONSUMER AFFAIRS,
FOOD AND PUBLIC DISTRIBUTION
be pleased to state:
(a) whether procurement of rice and
wheat has fallen this year as compared to
the last five years; and
(b) if so, the details thereof and the
reasons therefor?
Gulbarga-Bidar rail route
†*243. SHRI BASAW ARAJ PA TIL:
Will the Minister of RAILW AYS be pleased
to state:
(a) the date on which work on Gulbarga-
Bidar rail route commenced and the
estimated expenditure thereof at that time;
(b) the progress made in this regard so
far; and
(c) by when train service between
Gulbarga and Bidar would start operating?
Electoral reforms
*244. SHRI RAJEEV CHANDRA-
SEKHAR: Will the Minister of LAW AND
JUSTICE be pleased to state:
(a) whether the Law Commission has
sought inputs from civil society, experts,
political parties and other stakeholders on
electoral reforms; and
(b) if so, the steps Government
proposes to take after taking into account
these inputs?
Rise in prices of essential
commodities
*245. SHRI P. RAJEEVE: Will the
Minister of CONSUMER AFFAIRS,
FOOD AND PUBLIC DISTRIBUTION
be pleased to state:
(a) whether prices of essential
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

88
commodities have risen during the last three
years, if so, the details thereof;
(b) whether Government has taken any
steps to address this issue; and
(c) whether Government has made any
changes in allocation of wheat to APL card
holders, if so, the details thereof?
Facilities for disabled and sick
*246. SHRI VIJAY JAWAHARLAL
DARDA: Will the Minister of RAILW AYS
be pleased to state:
(a) the details of efforts made by
Railways to equip its trains and stations to
support sick, infirm and handicapped;
(b) whether Government is aware that
most of the railway stations, compartments
and platforms lack facilities to support
such people; and
(c) whether Government would ensure
that at least stations in major cities provide
adequate support facilities to disabled and
sick people where people come for
treatment, if not, the reasons therefor?
Development of Food Processing
Industries
*247. SHRIMATI RAJANI PATIL:
Will the Minister of FOOD PROCESSING
INDUSTRIES be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government has conducted
surveys/studies to assess the potential for
development of Food Processing Industries
(FPIs) in the country including
Maharashtra;
(b) if so, the details of the outcome
thereof indicating the estimated requirement
of food processing facilities in various
States of the country including Maharashtra;
and
(c) the steps taken/proposed to be taken
by Government to provide the required
facilities for development of FPIs?
Proposals for permission of railway
crossings
*248. SHRIMATI SMRITI ZUBIN
IRANI: Will the Minister of RAILWAYS
be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that several
proposals for permission of railway
crossings for various water supply
projects, affecting water supply to large
number of villages in Gujarat, are pending
with Government, if so, the details thereof;
and
(b) by when such proposals are likely
to be cleared?
Capacity of phone tapping
mechanism
*249. DR. K.P. RAMALINGAM: Will
the Minister of  COMMUNICATIONS
AND INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY
be pleased to state:
(a) whether country's phone tapping
mechanism would start with a curtailed
capacity as BSNL has failed to augment its
legacy switches with modern ones, if so,
the reasons therefor;
(b) whether LEAs would not be able to
utilize optimum capacity of CMS from the
very first day, despite having spent crores
on its development based on the US' Prism
project; and
(c) whether BSNL was supposed to
provide modern switches with a capacity
to simultaneously monitor 5,000 calls, but
it has failed to upgrade its system and would
provide tapping capacity of just 1,500 calls
and if so, the details thereof?

89
Payment of dues to farmers
*250. DR. T.N. SEEMA: Will the
Minister of CONSUMER AFFAIRS,
FOOD AND PUBLIC DISTRIBUTION
be pleased to state:
(a) whether one major problem in sugar
sector is non-payment of dues to farmers
in time by sugar mills;
(b) if so, the details thereof and the
reasons therefor indicating total amount due
to farmers during each of the last three years
and

RAJYA  SABHA
————
List of Questions for WRITTEN ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Friday, February 7, 2014/Magha 18, 1935 (Saka)
————
(Ministries : Agriculture; Chemicals and Fertilizers; Communications and
Information Technology; Consumer Affairs, Food and Public Distribution;
Food Processing Industries; Law and Justice; Railways;
Statistics and Programme Implementation)
Total number of questions — 132
Decrease in aquatic wealth along
Tamil Nadu coast
1735. DR. CHANDAN MITRA: Will
the Minister of AGRICULTURE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether the fish and aquatic wealth
along Tamil Nadu coast has decreased to a
large extent forcing the fishermen to trespass
the international boundary;
(b) if so, the details thereof along with
the reasons therefor;
(c) whether Government has taken any
steps to check unsustainable fishing
practices and over exploitation of coastal
waters including bottom trawling; and
(d) if so, the details thereof and if not,
the reasons therefor?
Making agriculture profitable
1736. SHRIMATI KUSUM RAI:
SHRI ALOK TIWARI:
Will the Minister of AGRICULTURE
be pleased to state:
(a) whether as per the India Rural
Development Report released on 26
September, 2013, income from farming is
no longer sufficient for 85 per cent farmers'
households, if so, the response of
Government thereto;
(b) whether Government is aware that
farmers are compelled to give up their
profession due to its non-profitability, if
so, the details thereof, State-wise;
(c) whether Government would
encourage new crop models, revive
traditional crops and take other measures
to make agriculture profitable; and
(d) if so, the details thereof and if not,
the reasons therefor?
Decline in agricultural growth
1737. SHRIMATI RAJANI PATIL:
SHRI K.C. TYAGI:
Will the Minister of AGRICULTURE
be pleased to state:
(a) whether share of agriculture in the
Gross Domestic Product of the country
has declined and is impacting the food
security;

469
(b) if so, details thereof along with the
share of agriculture in the GDP during last
four years and current year;
(c) details of the impact of global
economic slowdown on the agriculture
sector in the country;
(d) whether various projects/schemes
launched by Government have been able to
reverse the decline in agricultural growth;
and
(e) if not, reasons therefor and the
reaction of Government thereto along with
the corrective measures being taken in this
regard?
R & D for agricultural crops
1738. SHRI VIJAY JAWAHARLAL
DARDA: Will the Minister of
AGRICULTURE be pleased to state:
(a) whether any research projects, with
particular reference to rain-fed crops of
Vidarbha region were undertaken during
2010-11, 2011-12 and 2012-13;
(b) if so, whether such research and
development of agricultural crops stood the
test of ground realities for giving benefits
to marginal and poor farmers, who are
committing suicide during the last many
years due to high cost of inputs for
agriculture operations and not getting
remunerative prices thereof; and
(c) whether any dedicated schemes of
cropping pattern were adopted for six
adversely affected districts of Vidarbha-
Yavatmal, Akola, Washim, Buldhana,
Amravati and Wardha?
Production of vegetables
1739. DR. CHANDAN MITRA: Will
the Minister of AGRICULTURE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether the Indo-Israel Centre of
Excellence for Vegetables, Gharonda, has
developed certain new and hybrid varieties
of various vegetables including tomato,
capsicum and cucumber;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) the steps taken by Government to
set up such small centres, across the country
on the lines of Gharonda Unit for transfer
of technology to farmers for ensuring
increased production of vegetables in the
country especially in Madhya Pradesh?
FMD Control Programme
1740. DR. CHANDAN MITRA: Will
the Minister of AGRICULTURE be
pleased to state:
(a) the estimated annual loss in
production of milk and meat due to Foot
and Mouth Disease (FMD), State-wise;
(b) whether Government proposes to
expand the FMD Control Programme
(FMD-CP) to certain more districts and if
so, the details thereof, State-wise; and
(c) the steps taken by Government to
expand FMD-CP all over the country in a
phased and time-bound manner to totally
eradicate this disease from the country?
Shrinking in acreage of land under
cultivation in hilly areas
†1741. SHRI MAHENDRA SINGH
MAHRA: Will the Minister of
AGRICULTURE be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government is aware that
due to the increasing influence of wild
animals in the hilly areas of Uttarakhand,
farmers have reduced acreage of land under
cultivation in those areas;
(b) if so, whether Government would
constitute a team of agricultural scientists
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

470
to explore the measures for carrying out
alternative farming in place of agricultural
crops; and
(c) if not, the steps Ministry is going to
take to compensate the shrinkage in acreage
of land under cultivation in hilly areas?
